name: Realm: mangrove bayou (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic mangrove bayou photographed on location like a feature-film still - black water, tangled roots, hanging moss, stilted timber houses and lantern boats, thick humid air with low mist and muted green-grey light; any magic is a faint pale glow in the mist
notes: The poison homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/poison/ (set components.realm).
